title.zh:
富士静景，
东京热游

intro.zh:
「先在河口湖慢下来，
再一头扎进东京的街区、夜景和购物袋。」
intro.en:
“First, slow down at Lake Kawaguchi.
Then dive into Tokyo's streets, night views, and shopping bags.”

title.zh: 七天，从富士山脚走到东京霓虹
title.en: Seven Days from Fuji's Foothills to Tokyo Neon

subtitle.zh: 河口湖 · 上野 · 浅草 · 涩谷 · 银座 · 横滨 · 丰岛园
subtitle.en: Kawaguchiko · Ueno · Asakusa · Shibuya · Ginza · Yokohama · Toshimaen

paragraphs.zh: 这趟十一月的日本旅行以河口湖开场：先住进富士吟景，在湖边温泉旅馆看富士山；再回到东京，以高田马场的相铁 Grand Fresa 为据点，把上野、浅草、原宿、涩谷、皇居、银座、秋叶原和横滨串成一条越来越热闹的路线。
paragraphs.en: This November trip opened at Lake Kawaguchi. We stayed at Fuji Ginkei, watching Mount Fuji from a lakeside onsen hotel, then returned to Tokyo and used Sotetsu Grand Fresa Takadanobaba as a base for Ueno, Asakusa, Harajuku, Shibuya, the Imperial Palace, Ginza, Akihabara, and Yokohama.

paragraphs.zh: 最后一天留给东京哈利波特影城，返程前还在日上免税补上最大一笔购物。原笔记把总花费概括为约 2 万元；比景点更醒目的，是一路不断变厚的购物清单。
paragraphs.en: The final day belonged to the Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo, followed by the trip's largest shopping charge at Sunrise Duty Free. The original note summarizes the total at about RMB 20,000. As memorable as the sights were, the shopping list kept growing just as quickly.

title.zh: 河口湖，把节奏交给富士山
title.en: Lake Kawaguchi, Moving at Mount Fuji's Pace

paragraphs.zh: 从东京出发来到河口湖，住进湖边的富士吟景。推开窗就是富士山，温泉旅馆的安静让整趟旅行先慢了下来。天气并不完美，但山、湖和低低的云仍然足够让人停下来多看一会儿。
paragraphs.en: We came from Tokyo to Lake Kawaguchi and checked into Fuji Ginkei beside the water. Mount Fuji filled the view when we opened the window, and the quiet onsen hotel slowed the whole trip down before it had properly begun. The weather was not perfect, but the mountain, lake, and low clouds still made us stop and look.

paragraphs.zh: 两天里经过河口湖站、新仓山浅间公园一带，也把忍野八海与河口湖音乐森林附近的炸鸡店记进路线。这里没有东京那么满，风景本身就是行程。
paragraphs.en: The two days took us through Kawaguchiko Station and the Chureito Pagoda area, with Oshino Hakkai and a karaage shop near the Kawaguchiko Music Forest also saved on the route. Nothing here felt as packed as Tokyo; the scenery itself was the itinerary.

title.zh: 从上野的朱红鸟居走到浅草夜街
title.en: From Ueno's Vermilion Banners to Asakusa at Night

paragraphs.zh: 回到东京后先逛上野公园，再一路走向浅草寺。花园稻荷神社的红色奉纳旗、手里的御守、香炉升起的烟和浅草寺招牌，把这天的寺社记忆拼得很具体。
paragraphs.en: Back in Tokyo, we started in Ueno Park and continued toward Senso-ji. The red prayer banners at Hanazono Inari Shrine, a charm held in one hand, incense smoke, and Senso-ji's signs made the day's shrine memories unusually tangible.

paragraphs.zh: 浅草商店街的氛围很好，白天的参拜动线到了晚上变成招牌、路口和人流，顺手淘了一些小纪念品。东京国立博物馆也在这一区的收藏路线里。
paragraphs.en: Asakusa's shopping streets had a great atmosphere. The daytime temple route turned into signs, intersections, and crowds after dark, and we picked up a few small souvenirs along the way. The Tokyo National Museum was also saved among the stops in this area.

title.zh: 原宿、表参道与涩谷的夜空
title.en: Harajuku, Omotesando, and the Sky Above Shibuya

paragraphs.zh: 白天的路线在明治神宫、原宿、表参道与根津美术馆一带展开，到了晚上，Shibuya Sky 成了这天最强烈的记忆。站在高处，东京不再是一条街，而是一整片向远处延伸的灯光。
paragraphs.en: The daytime route moved around Meiji Jingu, Harajuku, Omotesando, and the Nezu Museum area. At night, Shibuya Sky became the day's strongest memory. From above, Tokyo stopped being a sequence of streets and became an entire field of light stretching toward the horizon.

paragraphs.zh: 购物也在这天突然加速：ATOMS 两件 T 恤 11,019 日元；PSG 店一件 T 恤加一件卫衣 31,900 日元；ABC Mart 的 Nike 板鞋 14,000 日元；两件 Aape 毛衣 28,666 日元；Air Jordan 板鞋 18,315 日元。原笔记合计 103,900 日元，约 5,082 元。
paragraphs.en: Shopping accelerated too: two ATOMS T-shirts for JPY 11,019; a T-shirt and sweatshirt at the PSG store for JPY 31,900; Nike sneakers at ABC Mart for JPY 14,000; two Aape sweaters for JPY 28,666; and Air Jordan sneakers for JPY 18,315. The note totals Day 4 at JPY 103,900, or about RMB 5,082.

title.zh: 皇居到银座，再去秋叶原看雨夜
title.en: Imperial Palace to Ginza, Then Akihabara in the Rain

paragraphs.zh: 这天从皇居一带的开阔道路走进银座整齐的商业建筑，再转向秋叶原。东京的反差被压在一天里：树木与商务区、GINZA SIX 的玻璃幕墙、密集招牌，以及雨水反射出来的夜色。
paragraphs.en: We moved from the open roads around the Imperial Palace into Ginza's ordered commercial blocks, then on to Akihabara. Tokyo's contrasts fit into one day: trees and business towers, the glass façade of GINZA SIX, dense signs, and rain reflecting the city after dark.

paragraphs.zh: 购物记录比行程更简短：优衣库 1,060.52 元。前一天的大采购之后，这个数字反而显得克制。
paragraphs.en: The shopping record is much shorter: RMB 1,060.52 at Uniqlo. After the previous day's haul, the number almost looks restrained.

title.zh: “捕鸟大厦”、城市穿行与横滨天际线
title.en: The “Bird-Catching Building,” Tokyo Streets, and Yokohama's Skyline

paragraphs.zh: 原笔记把这天写成“捕鸟大厦 & 横滨”。照片从一座利落的立方体建筑开始，经过广场、高架铁路、施工中的街区与动漫招牌，最后抵达横滨地标塔天际线。东京的密度被一路带到港口边。
paragraphs.en: The original note labels this day “Bird-Catching Building & Yokohama.” The photographs begin with a crisp cubic building, pass through plazas, elevated rail, a street under construction, and anime signs, then end at the Yokohama Landmark Tower skyline. Tokyo's density followed us all the way to the harbor.

paragraphs.zh: 当天买了两件始祖鸟，4,850.06 元；堂吉诃德 118.79 元。原笔记把 Day 6 总计记为 5,698.85 元，这里按原记录保留。
paragraphs.en: We bought two Arc'teryx pieces for RMB 4,850.06 and spent RMB 118.79 at Don Quijote. The original journal records the Day 6 total as RMB 5,698.85, which is preserved here as written.

title.zh: 走进哈利波特片场，然后回家
title.en: Into the Harry Potter Sets, Then Home

subtitle.zh: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo · The Making of Harry Potter
subtitle.en: Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo · The Making of Harry Potter

paragraphs.zh: 最后一天去了东京华纳兄弟哈利波特影城。对哈迷来说，这里确实像圣地：电影里的海报、服装、道具与布景从屏幕里变成立体空间，连搅动发光坩埚这样的互动也足够让人停很久。
paragraphs.en: The last day went to Warner Bros. Studio Tour Tokyo. For a Harry Potter fan, it really did feel like a pilgrimage: posters, costumes, props, and sets stepped out of the screen and became full rooms, while interactions such as stirring a glowing cauldron made it easy to linger.

paragraphs.zh: 返程前的购物仍然没有收手：松本清药妆 853.96 元、哈利波特周边 585.02 元、祖马龙香水 758.83 元、伴手礼 720.60 元、日上免税 4,438.55 元；Day 7 合计 7,356.96 元。
paragraphs.en: Shopping continued before the flight: RMB 853.96 at Matsumoto Kiyoshi, RMB 585.02 in Harry Potter merchandise, RMB 758.83 for Jo Malone perfume, RMB 720.60 in gifts, and RMB 4,438.55 at Sunrise Duty Free. Day 7 totaled RMB 7,356.96.

paragraphs.zh: 另一半行李箱属于药妆、零食与伴手礼。哈利波特周边单独成组，眼药水、感冒药、护肤品与点心盒则把返程前的采购铺得密密麻麻；三把陶瓷刀是其中最不一样的一组。
paragraphs.en: The other half of the suitcase belonged to drugstore products, snacks, and gifts. Harry Potter merchandise formed its own group; eye drops, cold remedies, skincare, and confectionery boxes filled the rest of the floor. Three ceramic knives were the most unexpected set.

title.zh: 前半程看山，后半程把东京装进行李箱
title.en: A Quiet Mountain First, Then Tokyo Packed into the Suitcase

subtitle.zh: Lake quiet · city lights · a very full suitcase
subtitle.en: Lake quiet · city lights · a very full suitcase

paragraphs.zh: 回看这七天，河口湖和东京像两种完全不同的速度。前两天的记忆是窗外富士山、湖水与温泉旅馆；之后则是浅草香火、涩谷高空夜景、银座玻璃幕墙、秋叶原雨夜、横滨天际线和哈利波特片场。
paragraphs.en: Looking back, Lake Kawaguchi and Tokyo moved at completely different speeds. The first two days are remembered through Mount Fuji outside the window, lake water, and an onsen hotel. Then came Asakusa incense, Shibuya's high night view, Ginza glass, Akihabara rain, Yokohama's skyline, and the Harry Potter sets.

paragraphs.zh: 购物确实买得很多，甚至足以单独成为两页。但真正把旅行串起来的，还是那些尺度变化：从一座山的安静，到一整座城市的灯光，再到回家后把每件战利品铺开拍照的满足感。
paragraphs.en: There was enough shopping to fill two whole pages. Yet the trip is held together by its shifts in scale: from the stillness of one mountain to an entire city of lights, then the satisfaction of laying every purchase out again after coming home.

paragraphs.zh: 富士山留在窗外，东京被装进行李箱。
paragraphs.en: Mount Fuji stayed outside the window; Tokyo went into the suitcase.

paragraphs.zh: 七天很满，照片更多，
paragraphs.en: Seven full days, even more photographs,

paragraphs.zh: 而下一次日本旅行，仍然有新的街区可走。
paragraphs.en: and still another Japanese neighborhood to walk next time.
